    try:
        market = binance.market(symbol)
        params = {
            'symbol': market['id'],

        }
        response = binance.fapiPrivate_post_margintype(params)
        print(f"Margin type for {symbol} set at {margin_type}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error when setting margin type: {e}")
